title: CitizenshipBackExtractionSchema
description: Schema for structured data extraction from the back of a Nepali Citizenship Certificate, including thumb impressions and issuing authority block.

citizenship_type.description: Type of citizenship as specified in the section labelled citizenship type/kisim (e.g. 'वंशज'). Extract exactly as printed in Devanagari.

right_thumb_impression.description: Location or presence of the applicant's right thumb impression. Set to 'present' if a thumbprint is visually present or the placeholder is occupied, 'absent' if blank.

left_thumb_impression.description: Location or presence of the applicant's left thumb impression. Set to 'present' if a thumbprint is visually present or the placeholder is occupied, 'absent' if blank.

issuing_officer_signature.description: Signature field: return the officer's handwritten signature exactly as printed if legible, else return 'unreadable signature' or 'present' if the signature is only visually present.

issuing_officer_name.description: Name of the issuing officer (नाम थर) exactly as printed next to the signature field, in Devanagari.

issuing_officer_designation.description: Designation (दर्जा) of the issuing officer exactly as printed (e.g. प्रशासनिक अधिकृत).

issue_date_bs.description: Official issue date of the certificate as printed in the bottom-right section (in BS, e.g. २०६८-०९-२६). Preserve all digits, dashes, and formatting.
